text: The scheme emphasizes rapid payout features and strong public-private collaboration. It aligns with the modernization of Fiji's national payment system (RTGS) and broader disaster risk financing reforms. The initiative is part of a comprehensive strategy to move Fiji from ad-hoc disaster financing to pre-arranged, rules-based instruments, improving speed, transparency, and predictability of post-disaster liquidity.

metadata.solution_name: Sovereign Risk Transfer Scheme Development in Fiji
